name: Cream + deep red
prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Create one full landscape image, a variation of the attached approved remote-outpost hangar concept. Preserve its recognizable architecture, scale, slightly elevated corner camera angle, compact single Longhaul berth, rear ramp, nearby pickup and delivery floor grids, right-hand warm dispatch booth with three CRT service terminals, closed pressure bulkhead, dense purposeful cassette hardware and clear working aisles. Keep refined block-built hard-surface Blender/Godot game aesthetic and practical cozy Cold War space-industrial character. This is a restrained station paint and material design variation, not a new enormous hangar. Make the new painted color clearly visible even under the lighting: neutral warm-white task lights rather than a strong amber filter. Paint has matte enamel finish; charcoal structure and warm cream remain balancing neutrals. Keep monochrome green CRTs and restrained amber status lamps. No neon colored lighting or holograms. Remove wheeled pallet jacks/trolleys; hand-carried cargo boxes rest directly on marked gridded platforms. Retain the current cargo routes and overall room arrangement. No new decorative slogans or fictional logos. Palette: warm ivory cream with confident deep signal-red and oxblood-red painted structural brackets, booth lower panels, locker doors, pressure-door surround and ship identification stripe. Red covers around a quarter of painted surfaces, enough to feel richly colored but not extravagant. Cargo containers remain muted olive and gray, floor neutral gray with modest white and safety-yellow markings. The result feels like a well-used dependable civilian freight depot.
